target: ebr-coworker-005-arc — landing + console + confidence-gated build-EBR flow
note: p(true) = honest probability the bet holds in market/against evidence. required:true = the concept's market success depends on it (enters naive-survival product).

bets.bet: An MSP's existing EBR has enough structure to draft a coworker from ('show me your report')
bets.losing_condition: Common case is a deck/doc, not an 8-tab workbook; structure not recoverable; flow flatters the organized.
bets.evidence: onboarding shapes admit 3 quality tiers; Stefanie 'manual first' — many MSPs have no structured report

bets.bet: Confidence-gated partial delegation builds trust (hand back what it can't stand behind)
bets.losing_condition: Hands the hardest judgment to the least-capable user; ~50% are lost ('what do I do with this'); the confidence scoring itself is the product and is 100% hollow here.
bets.evidence: Lewis 2026-08-25: 50% need a premium translation/handholding coworker

bets.bet: Structure-first onboarding (reads structure, not judgment) is enough for v1
bets.losing_condition: The value is judgment (why amber); never captured; no teach-back loop so the coworker never improves at the only thing that matters.
bets.evidence: own rail; Lewis 'need the reasoning trail'

bets.bet: The EBR deliverable is a report-with-sections
bets.losing_condition: The durable artifact is a LIVING RISK REGISTER — findings owned, tracked over time, evidence preserved for legal; a document is not a system of record.
bets.evidence: Lewis 2026-08-25 (1:16, 3:21, 11:07): 'the consistent living breathing artifact should be the risk register'

bets.bet: EBR/QBR is the right day-1 coworker to build
bets.losing_condition: If the demanded first job were elsewhere. It is not — QBR Advisor is default #1.
bets.evidence: FSN-83143 DEC-006 (QBR Advisor priority 2.90, rank 1); Chris Dunlop 'most requested, where we start'. STRENGTH vs the ACP build's Triage-first error.

bets.bet: A ~4-minute self-serve build reflects how MSPs actually adopt
bets.losing_condition: 'Manual first, software later' pedagogy; ~50% of buyers lack the maturity/skill; no handholding or client-interview step.

bets.bet: N-zo is the right AI expert to power an EBR coworker
bets.losing_condition: N-zo is diagnostic/advisory, scoped to device/telemetry/patch, 'does not execute autonomous actions' — a category mismatch for business-narrative reasoning.

bets.bet: Cross-coworker feeds (Tabletop->risk etc.) are buildable and orchestratable
bets.losing_condition: Producing coworkers are 0/40 code; flat coworker model has no orchestration to chain them; Lewis wants both 'everything is an ingredient' AND 'fly solo'.

bets.bet: Evidence/traceability is a later concern, not the spine
bets.losing_condition: Traceability is the legal insurance policy + system-of-record; without kept evidence it's 'a reporting mechanism, not an attestation mechanism' and loses the GRC moat.
bets.evidence: Lewis 2026-08-25 (11:07-14:09) 'across from opposing counsel: prove it'

bets.bet: Sign-off owner (practitioner vs account lead / David vs Vanessa) is settled
bets.losing_condition: Activate gate asks the user to name a signer the product doesn't enforce; medium risk tier undefined.
